subject: Decision owners, sprint plan and mutual action map
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lowe <dana.lowe@medsys.com>, Tom Reynolds <treynolds@medsys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Decision owners, sprint plan and mutual action map

Hi Dana / Tom — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth to share with your team. Please confirm or correct any ownership or timelines below.

Summary of where we landed (short):
- Primary business objective: reduce claim-processing latency for internal QA by 60% and improve physician search relevance for chart retrieval.
- Decision criteria: latency SLOs (95th <= 450ms), cost per 1M tokens, security/compliance evidence (SOC2 + data-retention controls), and integration effort (1 FTE x 6 weeks).

Stakeholders and owners (as we recorded on the call):
- Economic buyer: Tom Reynolds — final sign-off for budget and procurement
- Security/legal reviewer: Dana Lowe — will coordinate with Procurement and Security
- Procurement: Nina Patel (you mentioned procurement loop) — procurement contract & payment terms
- Technical champion: (you referenced) Dr. Elias Park (engineering lead) — integration POC

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — v1 (attached):
1) Week 0 (this week) — Share MAP spreadsheet + SOC2 summary (owner: Rohan) [Attachment: MedSys_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf]
2) Week 1 — Technical deep-dive / integration checklist call (owner: Priyom) — target demo environment and sample data scope
3) Week 2 — Procurement kickoff (owner: Tom / Nina) — review commercial terms, NDA and procurement timelines
4) Week 3 — Pilot smoke test (owner: Dr. Elias / Priyom) — 1-week pilot validating latency SLOs on representative workload
5) Week 5 — Decision checkpoint (owner: Tom) — sign or request revised terms; target go/no-go

Immediate asks from Redwood:
- Dana: can you confirm procurement contact (Nina?) and timing expectations for legal review?
- Tom: is the internal budget calendar for May/June aligned with the timeline above?
- Team: please review MAP attachment and highlight any missing milestones or owners.

Next step I propose: 30-min procurement + legal sync (Tom, Nina, Dana, Laura) to be scheduled this week or early next week. I’ll circulate a calendar invite once you confirm availability.

Attachments: MedSys_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf

Thanks — talk soon.

Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

- Priyom: have a 10-min runbook focused on sample dataset anonymization and a short ops checklist (what we need from their infra team).

I’ll circulate the MAP sheet post-call with owners locked and the next milestone dates. Keep this tight — Tom wants a one-page summary for May 20.
